name: Automatic GitHub Actions failure and skipped-proof routing through Founder Control Room
acceptanceCriteria: The scanner captures exact workflow-run, job, pull-request or main-branch, and head-SHA evidence without mutating source code or workflow state.
Failed jobs with no executed steps or logs are classified as runner_startup_failure or workflow_no_jobs rather than application regressions.
Each failed GitHub job or step retains its own non-authorizing proof receipt instead of collapsing an entire failed run into one evidence receipt.

A clean local failure and a GitHub failure may share one source-neutral incident fingerprint only when repository, exact head SHA, and canonical failure key agree; dirty or unidentified local work is never cross-source correlatable.
Failure proof cookies are source-specific evidence markers with authority=false, merge_authority=false, proof_satisfied=false, browser_cookie=false, and authorizing=false.
Skipped unit and Playwright witnesses emit non-secret exact-head fingerprints and proof cookies with authority=false, remain investigation-required, and cannot satisfy complete proof.
Completed GitHub workflows are inspected for emitted test-skip receipts and skipped jobs even when the workflow conclusion is success.
Local verification reports skipped tests as warning evidence instead of silent green, and opt-in ingestion preserves each skip under its own fingerprint.
Local verification redacts environment-held secrets and common credential shapes before writing command-output tails; external failure ingestion does not publish raw stdout or stderr.
Scan-only reporting works without Supabase credentials and all credentials remain environment-only and absent from reports.

verification.evidence: Source contracts now cover cross-source exact-head incident identity, per-step failure proof receipts, dirty-worktree non-correlation, redacted local reports, exact failed-run routing, and local/GitHub skipped-proof observation. Exact-head workflow, real failed/skipped-run rehearsal, full suite, type/lint, Playwright, artifact inspection, review, and current-main ancestry remain required before merge.
